technical.summary: Mixed signals with overbought conditions and weak trend confirmation; short-term bullish structure conflicted by below-50MA positioning and negative MACD histogram suggest caution on swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 29 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal with mixed recent trades (2 sales, 1 purchase); market fear (41 score) presents potential contrarian opportunity but lacks confirming news data and conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (411.68), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings event in 29 days adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Parabolic SAR, Supertrend, and Hull MA confirm short-term bullish structure with price near support (107.59), offering defined risk entry in fear-driven market correction.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators, price below both 50MA/EMA, negative MACD histogram, weak ADX (24.59), zero fundamental conviction, VIX crisis conditions, and earnings binary risk in 29 days create overwhelming headwinds that invalidate technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows price at support with bullish SAR/Supertrend, but overbought oscillators and price below 50MA undermine conviction. Earnings in 29 days create uncompensated binary risk in already unfavourable macro environment.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis conditions (411.68) combined with earnings event in 29 days and negative MACD histogram suggest high probability of mean reversion or gap risk that invalidates technical support structure.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical setup insufficient to overcome fundamental weakness, sentiment void, and macro headwinds
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MMM with 15 existing Industrials positions (30.6% sector concentration); adding to existing position increases concentration risk without conviction improvement.
